message.content:
Based on the search results, **Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2** was released on:

- **April 25, 2017** - International release (in countries like Australia and Italy)
- **May 5, 2017** - United States and China release

The film had its world premiere on **April 19, 2017** in Los Angeles, California.

The movie was originally announced with a July 28, 2017 release date at San Diego Comic-Con in 2014, but Marvel later moved it up to May 5, 2017.
